# FILE: app/src/main/java/app/simple/positional/services/LocationService.kt
################################################################################
package app.simple.positional.services

import android.app.Service
import android.content.Intent
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.Looper
import androidx.localbroadcastmanager.content.LocalBroadcastManager
import app.simple.positional.util.ConditionUtils.isNull
import app.simple.positional.util.PermissionUtils

class LocationService : Service(), LocationListener {
    private var locationManager: LocationManager? = null
    private var handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var delay: Long = 1000

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent): IBinder? {
        return null
    }

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        locationManager = baseContext.getSystemService(LOCATION_SERVICE) as LocationManager
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        requestLastKnownLocation()
        return START_REDELIVER_INTENT
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        locationManager?.removeUpdates(this)
        handler.removeCallbacks(locationUpdater)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) {
        Intent().also { intent ->
            intent.action = "location"
            intent.putExtra("location", location)
            LocalBroadcastManager.getInstance(baseContext).sendBroadcast(intent)
        }
    }

    @Deprecated("Deprecated in Java")
    override fun onStatusChanged(provider: String, status: Int, extras: Bundle) {
        Intent().also { intent ->
            intent.action = "provider"
            intent.putExtra("location_provider", provider)
            LocalBroadcastManager.getInstance(baseContext).sendBroadcast(intent)
        }
    }

    override fun onProviderEnabled(provider: String) {
        requestLastKnownLocation()
        Intent().also { intent ->
            intent.action = "provider"
            intent.putExtra("location_provider", provider)
            LocalBroadcastManager.getInstance(baseContext).sendBroadcast(intent)
        }
    }

    override fun onProviderDisabled(provider: String) {
        handler.removeCallbacks(locationUpdater)
        Intent().also { intent ->
            intent.action = "provider"
            intent.putExtra("location_provider", provider)
            LocalBroadcastManager.getInstance(baseContext).sendBroadcast(intent)
        }
    }

    private val locationUpdater: Runnable = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            requestLocation()
            handler.postDelayed(this, delay)
        }
    }

    private fun requestLastKnownLocation() {
        if (PermissionUtils.checkPermission(applicationContext)) {
            var location: Location? = null

            when {
                locationManager!!.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) -> {
                    location = locationManager?.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)
                }
                locationManager!!.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) -> {
                    location = locationManager?.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
                }
                locationManager!!.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER) -> {
                    location = locationManager?.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER)
                }
            }

            if (location.isNull()) {
                handler.post(locationUpdater)
            } else {
                location?.provider = "Last Location"
                onLocationChanged(location!!)
                handler.post(locationUpdater)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun requestLocation() {
        if (PermissionUtils.checkPermission(applicationContext)) {
            when {
                locationManager!!.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) -> {
                    locationManager?.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, delay, 0f, this)
                }
                locationManager!!.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) -> {
                    locationManager?.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER, delay, 0f, this)
                }
                else -> {
                    locationManager?.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER, delay, 0f, this)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package app.simple.positional.singleton

object FloatingButtonStateCommunicator {
    private const val TAG = "FloatingButtonStateCommunicator"

    private var floatingButtonCurrentSize = 0
    private val floatingButtonStateCallbacks = mutableSetOf<FloatingButtonStateCallbacks>()

    fun setFloatingButtonSize(size: Int) {
        floatingButtonCurrentSize = size
    }

    fun addFloatingButtonStateCallbacks(callback: FloatingButtonStateCallbacks) {
        floatingButtonStateCallbacks.add(callback)
    }

    fun removeFloatingButtonStateCallbacks(callback: FloatingButtonStateCallbacks) {
        floatingButtonStateCallbacks.remove(callback)
    }

    fun notifyFloatingButtonStateChange(size: Int) {
        floatingButtonStateCallbacks.forEach {
            it.onFloatingButtonStateChange(size)
        }
    }

    interface FloatingButtonStateCallbacks {
        fun onFloatingButtonStateChange(size: Int)
    }
}

package app.simple.positional.singleton

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import app.simple.positional.util.ConditionUtils.isNull

object SharedPreferences {
    const val preferences = "Preferences"
    private var sharedPreferences: SharedPreferences? = null

    fun init(context: Context) {
        if (sharedPreferences.isNull()) {
            sharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences(preferences, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        }
    }

    fun getSharedPreferences(): SharedPreferences {
        return sharedPreferences ?: throw NullPointerException()
    }

    fun getSharedPreferences(context: Context): SharedPreferences {
        return if (sharedPreferences.isNull()) {
            context.getSharedPreferences(preferences, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        } else {
            sharedPreferences!!
        }
    }
}

package app.simple.positional.sparkline.extensions

import android.graphics.Path
import android.graphics.PointF
import app.simple.positional.sparkline.data.CurvePoints

fun Path.cubicTo(controlPoint1: PointF, controlPoint2: PointF, point2: PointF) {
    this.cubicTo(
            controlPoint1.x,
            controlPoint1.y,
            controlPoint2.x,
            controlPoint2.y,
            point2.x,
            point2.y
    )
}

fun Path.cubicTo(curvePoints: CurvePoints) {
    this.cubicTo(
            curvePoints.cp1.x,
            curvePoints.cp1.y,
            curvePoints.cp2.x,
            curvePoints.cp2.y,
            curvePoints.p2.x,
            curvePoints.p2.y
    )
}

package app.simple.positional.sparkline.view

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.*
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.util.Log
import android.view.View
import app.simple.positional.R
import app.simple.positional.sparkline.data.CurvePoints
import app.simple.positional.sparkline.extensions.cubicTo
import kotlin.math.ceil
import kotlin.math.min

class SparkLineLayout @JvmOverloads constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet? = null, defStyleAttr: Int = 0)
    : View(context, attrs, defStyleAttr) {
    companion object DefaultAttrs {
        private val SPARKLINE_COLOR = Color.parseColor("#222222")
        private val SPARKLINE_SECOND_COLOR = Color.parseColor("#222222")
        private val LINE_SPLIT_LEFT_COLOR = Color.parseColor("#222222")
        private val LINE_SPLIT_RIGHT_COLOR = Color.parseColor("#222222")
        private const val SPARKLINE_THICKNESS = 0F
        private const val SPARKLINE_BEZIER = 0.5F
        private const val MARKER_WIDTH = 0F
        private const val MARKER_HEIGHT = 0F
        private val MARKER_BACKGROUND_COLOR = Color.parseColor("#222222")
        private val MARKER_BORDER_COLOR = Color.parseColor("#222222")
        private const val MARKER_BORDER_SIZE = 0F
        private const val MARKER_IS_CIRCLE_STYLE = false
        private const val IS_SPLIT_LINE = false
        private const val IS_GRADIENT_LINE = false
        private const val SPLIT_LINE_RATIO = 0.5F
    }

    private var sparkLineColor: Int = SPARKLINE_COLOR
    private var sparkLineSecondColor: Int = SPARKLINE_SECOND_COLOR
    private var sparkLineThickness: Float = SPARKLINE_THICKNESS
    private var sparkLineBezier: Float = SPARKLINE_BEZIER
    private var markerWidth: Float = MARKER_WIDTH
    private var markerHeight: Float = MARKER_HEIGHT
    private var markerBackgroundColor: Int = MARKER_BACKGROUND_COLOR
    private var markerBorderColor: Int = MARKER_BORDER_COLOR
    private var markerBorderSize: Float = MARKER_BORDER_SIZE
    private var markerIsCircleStyle: Boolean = MARKER_IS_CIRCLE_STYLE
    private var splitLineRatio: Float = SPLIT_LINE_RATIO
    private var isSplitLine = IS_SPLIT_LINE
    private var lineSplitLeftColor = LINE_SPLIT_LEFT_COLOR
    private var lineSplitRightColor = LINE_SPLIT_RIGHT_COLOR
    private var isGradientLine = IS_GRADIENT_LINE

    private var paintSparkLine: Paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private var paintMarker: Paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private var paintMarkerStroke: Paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private var paintLineLeft: Paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private var paintLineRight: Paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)

    private var pathSparkLine: Path = Path()
    private var pathLineLeft: Path = Path()
    private var pathLineRight: Path = Path()

    private var inputData: ArrayList<Float> = arrayListOf()
    private var data: ArrayList<Float> = arrayListOf()

    private var dataMax: Float = 0f
    private var dataMin: Float = 0f
    private var xStep: Float = 0F
    private var yStep: Float = 0F
    private var heightPadding: Float = 0F

    init {
        if (attrs != null) {
            val styledAttrs = context.obtainStyledAttributes(
                    attrs,
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout, 0, 0
            )

            sparkLineColor =
                    styledAttrs.getColor(R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_line_color, SPARKLINE_COLOR)

            sparkLineThickness = styledAttrs.getDimension(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_line_thickness,
                    2F
            )

            sparkLineBezier =
                    styledAttrs.getFloat(R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_line_bezier, SPARKLINE_BEZIER)

            markerWidth =
                    styledAttrs.getDimension(R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_marker_width, MARKER_WIDTH)

            markerHeight =
                    styledAttrs.getDimension(R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_marker_height, MARKER_HEIGHT)

            markerBackgroundColor = styledAttrs.getColor(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_marker_background_color,
                    MARKER_BACKGROUND_COLOR
            )

            markerBorderColor = styledAttrs.getColor(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_marker_border_color,
                    MARKER_BORDER_COLOR
            )

            markerBorderSize = styledAttrs.getDimension(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_marker_border_size,
                    MARKER_BORDER_SIZE
            )

            markerIsCircleStyle = styledAttrs.getBoolean(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_marker_circle_style,
                    MARKER_IS_CIRCLE_STYLE
            )

            sparkLineSecondColor = styledAttrs.getColor(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_line_second_color,
                    SPARKLINE_SECOND_COLOR
            )

            isSplitLine = styledAttrs.getBoolean(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_split_line,
                    IS_SPLIT_LINE
            )

            isGradientLine = styledAttrs.getBoolean(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_gradient_line,
                    IS_GRADIENT_LINE
            )

            splitLineRatio = styledAttrs.getFloat(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_split_ratio,
                    SPLIT_LINE_RATIO
            )

            lineSplitLeftColor = styledAttrs.getColor(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_split_left_color,
                    LINE_SPLIT_LEFT_COLOR
            )

            lineSplitRightColor = styledAttrs.getColor(
                    R.styleable.SparkLineLayout_s_split_right_color,
                    LINE_SPLIT_RIGHT_COLOR
            )

            styledAttrs.recycle()
        }

        if (isInEditMode) {
            setData(
                    arrayListOf(
                            298F, 46F, 87F, 178F, 446F, 1167F, 1855F, 1543F, 662F, 1583F
                    )
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)

        canvas.let {
            if (data.isNotEmpty()) {
                initLocalVars()
                if (!isSplitLine) {
                    drawLine(it)
                } else {
                    drawSplitLine(it)
                }
                drawMarkers(it)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec: Int, heightMeasureSpec: Int) {
        val desiredWidth = suggestedMinimumWidth + paddingLeft + paddingRight
        val desiredHeight = suggestedMinimumHeight + paddingTop + paddingBottom

        setMeasuredDimension(
                measureDimension(desiredWidth, widthMeasureSpec),
                measureDimension(desiredHeight, heightMeasureSpec)
        )

        super.onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec, heightMeasureSpec)
        initPaint()
    }

    private fun measureDimension(desiredSize: Int, measureSpec: Int): Int {
        var result: Int
        val specMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(measureSpec)
        val specSize = MeasureSpec.getSize(measureSpec)

        if (specMode == MeasureSpec.EXACTLY) {
            result = specSize
        } else {
            result = desiredSize
            if (specMode == MeasureSpec.AT_MOST) {
                result = min(result, specSize)
            }
        }

        if (result < desiredSize) {
            Log.e("SparkLineLayout", "The view is too small")
        }

        return result
    }

    private fun getCountNumForMaxNum(num: Float): Float {
        var n = 0.1F
        return if (num > 100) {
            for (i in 0 until 8) {
                if (num * n < 100) {
                    break
                } else {
                    n *= 0.1F
                }
            }
            n
        } else {
            1F
        }
    }

    fun setData(arrayData: ArrayList<Float>) {
        inputData.clear()
        data.clear()
        inputData = ArrayList(arrayData)

        val num = getCountNumForMaxNum(inputData.maxOrNull() ?: 1F)

        inputData.forEach {
            data.add(it * num)
        }

        invalidate()
    }

    private fun initPaint() {
        paintSparkLine.color = sparkLineColor
        paintSparkLine.strokeWidth = sparkLineThickness
        paintSparkLine.strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        paintSparkLine.style = Paint.Style.STROKE

        if (isGradientLine) {
            paintSparkLine.shader = LinearGradient(
                    0F,
                    0F,
                    measuredWidth.toFloat(),
                    0f,
                    sparkLineColor,
                    sparkLineSecondColor,
                    Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
            )
        }

        paintMarker.style = Paint.Style.FILL
        paintMarker.color = markerBackgroundColor

        paintMarkerStroke.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        paintMarkerStroke.color = markerBorderColor
        paintMarkerStroke.strokeWidth = markerBorderSize

        paintLineLeft.color = lineSplitLeftColor
        paintLineLeft.strokeWidth = sparkLineThickness
        paintLineLeft.strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        paintLineLeft.style = Paint.Style.STROKE

        paintLineRight.color = lineSplitRightColor
        paintLineRight.strokeWidth = sparkLineThickness
        paintLineRight.strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        paintLineRight.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
    }

    private fun initLocalVars() {
        dataMax = data.maxOrNull() ?: 1f
        dataMin = data.minOrNull() ?: 1f
        val markerH = if (markerIsCircleStyle) markerWidth else markerHeight
        heightPadding = markerH + sparkLineThickness * 2

        xStep = (measuredWidth - heightPadding * 2) / (data.count() - 1).toFloat()
        yStep = (measuredHeight - heightPadding * 2) / (dataMax - dataMin)

        when {
            splitLineRatio < 0F -> splitLineRatio = 0F
            splitLineRatio > 1F -> splitLineRatio = 1F
        }
    }

    private fun drawLine(canvas: Canvas) {
        if (data.size < 0) {
            return
        }

        pathSparkLine = Path().apply {
            var xStart = heightPadding

            moveTo(xStart, measuredHeight - heightPadding - (data[0] - dataMin) * yStep)
            xStart += xStep
            for (index in 1 until data.size) {
                val prevVal: Float = getPrevVal(index)
                val nextVal: Float = getNextVal(index)
                val prevD = getPrevD(xStart, index, prevVal)
                val curD = getCurD(xStart, index, nextVal)
                val controlPoint1 = getControlPointLeft(xStart, prevVal, prevD)
                val controlPoint2 = getControlPointRight(xStart, index, curD)
                val currentPoint = getCurrentPoint(xStart, index)

                this.cubicTo(controlPoint1, controlPoint2, currentPoint)

                xStart += xStep
            }
        }

        canvas.drawPath(pathSparkLine, paintSparkLine)
    }

    private fun drawSplitLine(canvas: Canvas) {
        var xStart = heightPadding
        val numPoint = calculateSplitNumPoint()
        val t: Float = calculateRatioBetweenPoints()

        pathLineLeft.moveTo(xStart, measuredHeight - heightPadding - (data.first() - dataMin) * yStep)
        xStart += xStep
        for (index in 1 until data.size) {
            val prevVal: Float = getPrevVal(index)
            val nextVal: Float = getNextVal(index)
            val prevD = getPrevD(xStart, index, prevVal)
            val curD = getCurD(xStart, index, nextVal)
            val controlPoint1 = getControlPointLeft(xStart, prevVal, prevD)
            val controlPoint2 = getControlPointRight(xStart, index, curD)
            val currentPoint = getCurrentPoint(xStart, index)

            when {
                index < numPoint -> pathLineLeft.cubicTo(
                        controlPoint1,
                        controlPoint2,
                        currentPoint
                )
                index == numPoint -> {
                    val prevPoint: PointF = if (numPoint != 0) {
                        PointF(
                                xStart - xStep,
                                measuredHeight - heightPadding - (data[index - 1] - dataMin) * yStep
                        )
                    } else {
                        currentPoint
                    }

                    val cLeftPoint = splitCurve(prevPoint, controlPoint1, controlPoint2, currentPoint, t, false)
                    val cRightPoint = splitCurve(prevPoint, controlPoint1, controlPoint2, currentPoint, t, true)

                    pathLineLeft.cubicTo(cLeftPoint)
                    pathLineRight.moveTo(cRightPoint.p1.x, cRightPoint.p1.y)
                    pathLineRight.cubicTo(cRightPoint)
                }
                else -> pathLineRight.cubicTo(
                        controlPoint1,
                        controlPoint2,
                        currentPoint
                )
            }

            xStart += xStep
        }

        canvas.drawPath(pathLineRight, paintLineRight)
        canvas.drawPath(pathLineLeft, paintLineLeft)
    }

    private fun drawMarkers(canvas: Canvas) {
        for (i in 0 until data.size) {
            val x: Float = i * xStep
            val y: Float = measuredHeight - heightPadding - (data[i] - dataMin) * yStep

            drawMarker(canvas, x + heightPadding, y)
        }
    }

    private fun drawMarker(canvas: Canvas, x: Float, y: Float) {
        if (markerIsCircleStyle) {
            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, markerWidth / 2, paintMarker)
            if (markerBorderSize > 0) {
                canvas.drawCircle(x, y, markerWidth / 2, paintMarkerStroke)
            }
        } else {
            canvas.drawRect(
                    x - markerWidth / 2,
                    y - markerHeight / 2,
                    x + markerWidth / 2,
                    y + markerHeight / 2,
                    paintMarker
            )
            if (markerBorderSize > 0) {
                canvas.drawRect(
                        x - markerWidth / 2,
                        y - markerHeight / 2,
                        x + markerWidth / 2,
                        y + markerHeight / 2,
                        paintMarkerStroke
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun getPrevVal(index: Int): Float {
        return when {
            index > 0 -> data[index - 1] - dataMin
            else -> data[index] - dataMin
        }.toFloat()
    }

    private fun getNextVal(index: Int): Float {
        return (if (index < data.size - 1) {
            data[index + 1] - dataMin
        } else {
            data[index] - dataMin
        }).toFloat()
    }

    private fun getPrevD(xStart: Float, index: Int, prevVal: Float): PointF {
        return PointF(
                (xStart - (xStart - xStep)) * sparkLineBezier,
                (data[index] - dataMin - prevVal) * sparkLineBezier
        )
    }

    private fun getCurD(xStart: Float, index: Int, nextVal: Float): PointF {
        return PointF(
                (xStart + xStep - xStart) * sparkLineBezier,
                (nextVal - (data[index] - dataMin)) * sparkLineBezier
        )
    }

    private fun getControlPointLeft(xStart: Float, prevVal: Float, prevD: PointF): PointF {
        return PointF(
                xStart - xStep + prevD.x,
                measuredHeight - heightPadding - prevVal * yStep - prevD.y
        )
    }

    private fun getControlPointRight(xStart: Float, index: Int, curD: PointF): PointF {
        return PointF(
                xStart - curD.x,
                measuredHeight - heightPadding - (data[index] - dataMin) * yStep + curD.y
        )
    }

    private fun getCurrentPoint(xStart: Float, index: Int): PointF {
        return PointF(xStart,
                measuredHeight - heightPadding - (data[index] - dataMin) * yStep)
    }

    private fun calculateSplitNumPoint(): Int {
        val widthRatio = measuredWidth * splitLineRatio
        return when (splitLineRatio) {
            1.0F -> data.size - 1
            0.0F -> 0
            else -> ceil(widthRatio / xStep).toInt()
        }
    }

    private fun calculateRatioBetweenPoints(): Float {
        val widthRatio = measuredWidth * splitLineRatio
        return when (splitLineRatio) {
            1F -> 1F
            0F -> 0F
            else -> widthRatio % xStep / xStep
        }
    }

    private fun splitCurve(
            p1: PointF,
            cp1: PointF,
            cp2: PointF,
            p2: PointF,
            t: Float,
            reverse: Boolean
    ): CurvePoints {
        val p12 = calculateDistance(p1, cp1, t)
        val p23 = calculateDistance(cp1, cp2, t)
        val p34 = calculateDistance(cp2, p2, t)
        val p123 = calculateDistance(p12, p23, t)
        val p234 = calculateDistance(p23, p34, t)
        val p1234 = calculateDistance(p123, p234, t)

        return if (!reverse) {
            CurvePoints(p1, p12, p123, p1234)
        } else {
            CurvePoints(p1234, p234, p34, p2)
        }
    }

    private fun calculateDistance(point1: PointF, point2: PointF, t: Float): PointF {
        return PointF(
                (point2.x - point1.x) * t + point1.x,
                (point2.y - point1.y) * t + point1.y
        )
    }
}

@Immutable
data class AccentOption(@ColorInt val color: Int, val name: String, val dynamic: Boolean = false)

object AccentPalette {
    const val MATERIAL_YOU = "Material You (Dynamic)"

    val colors = listOf(
        R.color.positional to "Positional",
        R.color.blue to "Blue",
        R.color.blueGrey to "Blue Grey",
        R.color.darkBlue to "Dark Blue",
        R.color.red to "Red",
        R.color.green to "Green",
        R.color.orange to "Orange",
        R.color.purple to "Purple",
        R.color.yellow to "Yellow",
        R.color.caribbeanGreen to "Caribbean Green",
        R.color.persianGreen to "Persian Green",
        R.color.amaranth to "Amaranth",
        R.color.indian_red to "Indian Red",
        R.color.light_coral to "Light Coral",
        R.color.pink_flare to "Pink Flare",
        R.color.makeup_tan to "Makeup Tan",
        R.color.egg_yellow to "Egg Yellow",
        R.color.medium_green to "Medium Green",
        R.color.olive to "Olive",
        R.color.copperfield to "Copperfield",
        R.color.mineral_green to "Mineral Green",
        R.color.lochinvar to "Lochinvar",
        R.color.beach_grey to "Beach Grey",
    )

    fun options(context: Context): List<AccentOption> = buildList {
        colors.forEach { (res, name) -> add(AccentOption(context.getColor(res), name)) }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
            add(1, AccentOption(context.getColor(android.R.color.system_accent1_500), MATERIAL_YOU, dynamic = true))
        }
    }

    fun isSelected(option: AccentOption, @ColorInt selected: Int, materialYou: Boolean): Boolean =
        if (materialYou) option.dynamic else !option.dynamic && option.color == selected
}

@Composable
fun AccentColorScreen(
    options: List<AccentOption>,
    @ColorInt selected: Int,
    materialYou: Boolean,
    topInset: Dp,
    onSelect: (AccentOption) -> Unit,
) {
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        LazyColumn(contentPadding = PaddingValues(start = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, top = topInset, bottom = 16.dp)) {
            item {
                Text(
                    stringResource(R.string.accent_colors),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 16.dp),
                )
            }
            item {
                Text(
                    "${stringResource(R.string.total)} ${options.size}",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                )
            }
            items(options, key = { it.name }) { option ->
                AccentRow(option, AccentPalette.isSelected(option, selected, materialYou)) { onSelect(option) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun AccentRow(option: AccentOption, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    val color = Color(option.color)
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(shape)
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(10.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Box(
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(width = 100.dp, height = 70.dp)
                .shadow(5.dp, shape, ambientColor = color, spotColor = color)
                .background(color, shape),
        ) {
            if (selected) Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_check), contentDescription = null, tint = Color.White)
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.width(16.dp))
        Column {
            Text(option.name, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            Text(
                option.color.toHex(),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
        }
    }
}

import androidx.annotation.DrawableRes
import androidx.compose.foundation.Image

import app.simple.positional.constants.LauncherBackground
import app.simple.positional.util.BitmapHelper.addLinearGradient
import app.simple.positional.util.BitmapHelper.toBitmapKeepingSize

data class Art(@param:DrawableRes val background: Int, val startColor: Int, val endColor: Int)

object ArtsCatalog {
    val arts: List<Art> = (LauncherBackground.vectorBackground + LauncherBackground.vectorBackgroundNight)
        .zip(LauncherBackground.vectorColors + LauncherBackground.vectorNightColors) { background, colors ->
            Art(background, colors[0], colors[1])
        }
}

private val logoFont = FontFamily(Font(R.font.logo))

@Composable
fun ArtsScreen(initialPage: Int, cornerRadius: Dp, @DrawableRes pin: Int, onPageSettled: (Int) -> Unit) {
    val arts = ArtsCatalog.arts
    val state = rememberPagerState(initialPage = initialPage.coerceIn(0, arts.lastIndex)) { arts.size }
    LaunchedEffect(state) { snapshotFlow { state.settledPage }.collect { onPageSettled(it) } }
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        VerticalPager(state = state, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().systemBarsPadding(), beyondViewportPageCount = 1) { page ->
            ArtCard(arts[page], page, arts.size, cornerRadius, pin)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ArtCard(art: Art, index: Int, count: Int, cornerRadius: Dp, pin: Int) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(cornerRadius)
    val glow = Color(art.startColor)
    val icon = remember(art, pin) {
        pin.toBitmapKeepingSize(context, 6, 255).addLinearGradient(intArrayOf(art.startColor, art.endColor)).asImageBitmap()
    }
    Box(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(dimensionResource(R.dimen.options_container_horizontal_padding))
            .shadow(25.dp, shape, ambientColor = glow, spotColor = glow)
            .clip(shape)
            .background(colorResource(R.color.toolbarBackground)),
    ) {
        Text(
            "${index + 1}/$count",
            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).padding(25.dp),
            color = colorResource(R.color.textTertiary),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
        )
        Column(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter).padding(top = 75.dp), horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
            Text(
                stringResource(R.string.app_name),
                fontFamily = logoFont,
                fontSize = with(LocalDensity.current) { dimensionResource(R.dimen.launcher_app_title).toSp() },
                color = colorResource(R.color.textSecondary),
            )
            Image(icon, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp).size(dimensionResource(R.dimen.launcher_app_icon_dimen)))
        }
        Image(
            painterResource(art.background),
            contentDescription = null,
            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomCenter).fillMaxWidth(),
            contentScale = ContentScale.FillWidth,
        )
    }
}

package app.simple.positional.ui.compose

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectable
import androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectableGroup
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.material3.TextButton
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.Immutable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment

import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.Role
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

@Immutable
data class Choice<T>(val value: T, val label: String, val description: String? = null)

@Composable
fun <T> ChoiceDialog(
    title: String,
    choices: List<Choice<T>>,
    selected: T,
    note: String? = null,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onSelect: (T) -> Unit,
) {
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.cancel)) }
        },
        title = { Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge) },
        text = {
            Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).selectableGroup()) {
                choices.forEach { choice ->
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .selectable(
                                selected = choice.value == selected,
                                role = Role.RadioButton,
                                onClick = { onSelect(choice.value) },
                            )
                            .padding(vertical = 10.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    ) {
                        RadioButton(selected = choice.value == selected, onClick = null)
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(16.dp))
                        Column {
                            Text(choice.label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                            if (choice.description != null) {
                                Text(
                                    choice.description,
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (note != null) {
                    Text(
                        note,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp),
                    )
                }
            }
        },
        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
    )
}

import androidx.compose.foundation.ExperimentalFoundationApi

@Stable
class CustomLocationForm {
    var address by mutableStateOf("")
    var latitude by mutableStateOf("")
    var longitude by mutableStateOf("")

    fun fill(address: String, latitude: String, longitude: String) {
        this.address = address
        this.latitude = latitude
        this.longitude = longitude
    }
}

object CoordinateInput {
    fun parse(latitude: String, longitude: String): Pair<Double, Double>? {
        val lat = latitude.toCoordinate() ?: return null
        val lon = longitude.toCoordinate() ?: return null
        return if (lat in -90.0..90.0 && lon in -180.0..180.0) lat to lon else null
    }

    fun format(value: Double): String = MathExtensions.round(value, 6).toString()

    private fun String.toCoordinate(): Double? = trim().replace(',', '.').toDoubleOrNull()
}

interface CustomLocationActions {
    fun search()
    fun save(latitude: Double, longitude: Double)
    fun setLocation(latitude: Double, longitude: Double, save: Boolean)
    fun select(location: Locations)
    fun useLocation(location: Locations)
    fun delete(location: Locations)
    fun deleteAll()
    fun help()
    fun failed()
}

@Composable
fun CustomLocationScreen(form: CustomLocationForm, locations: List<Locations>?, topInset: Dp, actions: CustomLocationActions) {
    var confirmDelete by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(top = topInset)) {
            Header(form, actions) { confirmDelete = true }
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = form.address,
                onValueChange = { form.address = it },
                label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.gps_address)) },
                maxLines = 3,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
            )
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(start = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, top = 8.dp)) {
                CoordinateField(form.latitude, R.string.specified_hint_latitude, Modifier.weight(1f)) { form.latitude = it }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                CoordinateField(form.longitude, R.string.specified_hint_longitude, Modifier.weight(1f)) { form.longitude = it }
            }
            HorizontalDivider(Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp), thickness = Dp.Hairline, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline)
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                when {
                    locations == null -> Unit
                    locations.isEmpty() -> Image(
                        painterResource(R.drawable.art_empty),
                        contentDescription = null,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(200.dp).align(Alignment.Center),
                    )
                    else -> LazyColumn(
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    ) {
                        items(locations, key = { it.date }) { LocationCard(it, actions) }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (confirmDelete) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { confirmDelete = false },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    confirmDelete = false
                    actions.deleteAll()
                }) { Text(stringResource(R.string.sure)) }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { confirmDelete = false }) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.cancel)) }
            },
            title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.delete_all), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge) },
            containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun Header(form: CustomLocationForm, actions: CustomLocationActions, onDeleteAll: () -> Unit) {
    var menu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val iconTint = colorResource(R.color.iconColor)
    fun submit(block: (Double, Double) -> Unit) {
        menu = false
        CoordinateInput.parse(form.latitude, form.longitude)?.let { (lat, lon) -> block(lat, lon) } ?: actions.failed()
    }
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(start = 16.dp, end = 8.dp, top = 8.dp, bottom = 8.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Text(stringResource(R.string.specified_hint_header), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
        IconButton(onClick = actions::search) {
            Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_search), contentDescription = null, tint = iconTint)
        }
        Box {
            IconButton(onClick = { menu = true }) {
                Icon(
                    painterResource(R.drawable.ic_menu),
                    contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.open_specified_location_documentation),
                    tint = iconTint,
                )
            }
            DropdownMenu(expanded = menu, onDismissRequest = { menu = false }) {
                MenuEntry(R.string.save) { submit(actions::save) }
                MenuEntry(R.string.set_and_save) { submit { lat, lon -> actions.setLocation(lat, lon, save = true) } }
                MenuEntry(R.string.set_only) { submit { lat, lon -> actions.setLocation(lat, lon, save = false) } }
                MenuEntry(R.string.delete_all) {
                    menu = false
                    onDeleteAll()
                }
                MenuEntry(R.string.help) {
                    menu = false
                    actions.help()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MenuEntry(label: Int, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(stringResource(label), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium) }, onClick = onClick)
}

@Composable
internal fun CoordinateField(value: String, label: Int, modifier: Modifier, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onValueChange,
        label = { Text(stringResource(label)) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Decimal),
        modifier = modifier,
    )
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
private fun LocationCard(location: Locations, actions: CustomLocationActions) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
    val latitude = remember(location.latitude) { DMSConverter.getFormattedLatitude(location.latitude, context) }
    val longitude = remember(location.longitude) { DMSConverter.getFormattedLongitude(location.longitude, context) }
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(shape)
            .border(Dp.Hairline, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline, shape)
            .combinedClickable(onClick = { actions.select(location) }, onLongClick = { actions.useLocation(location) })
            .padding(start = 16.dp, top = 12.dp, bottom = 12.dp, end = 4.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(location.address, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            Text(latitude, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            Text(longitude, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        }
        IconButton(onClick = { actions.delete(location) }) {
            Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_clear), contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.delete), tint = colorResource(R.color.iconColor))
        }
    }
}

object MapSearchQuery {
    const val DELAY = 800L
    const val MAX_RESULTS = 10
    private const val MIN_LENGTH = 3

    fun normalize(text: String): String? = text.trim().takeIf { it.length >= MIN_LENGTH }
}

interface MapSearchActions {
    fun addressChanged(text: String)
    fun pick(address: Address)
    fun cancel()
    fun confirm()
}

@Composable
fun MapSearchScreen(form: CustomLocationForm, suggestions: List<Address>, map: View, actions: MapSearchActions) {
    val iconTint = colorResource(R.color.iconColor)
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().safeDrawingPadding()) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(start = 16.dp, end = 8.dp, top = 8.dp, bottom = 8.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.specified_hint_header), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                IconButton(onClick = actions::cancel) {
                    Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_clear), contentDescription = stringResource(android.R.string.cancel), tint = iconTint)
                }
                IconButton(onClick = actions::confirm) {
                    Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_check), contentDescription = stringResource(android.R.string.ok), tint = iconTint)
                }
            }
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = form.address,
                onValueChange = actions::addressChanged,
                label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.gps_address)) },
                singleLine = true,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
            )
            suggestions.forEach { address ->
                Text(
                    address.getAddressLine(0).orEmpty(),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    maxLines = 2,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable { actions.pick(address) }.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                )
            }
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(start = 16.dp, end = 16.dp, top = 8.dp)) {
                CoordinateField(form.latitude, R.string.specified_hint_latitude, Modifier.weight(1f)) { form.latitude = it }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                CoordinateField(form.longitude, R.string.specified_hint_longitude, Modifier.weight(1f)) { form.longitude = it }
            }
            HorizontalDivider(Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp), thickness = Dp.Hairline, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline)
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().weight(1f)) {
                AndroidView(factory = { map }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize())

                    contentDescription = null,
                    tint = colorResource(R.color.iconRegular),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(30.dp).align(Alignment.Center),
                )

import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.res.colorResource

import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.Font
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import androidx.core.content.res.use
import app.simple.positional.R

object PositionalFonts {
    val regular = FontFamily(Font(R.font.regular))
    val medium = FontFamily(Font(R.font.medium, FontWeight.Medium))
    val heading = FontFamily(Font(R.font.heading, FontWeight.Bold))
}

private val typography = Typography(
    headlineMedium = TextStyle(fontFamily = PositionalFonts.heading, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 31.sp),
    titleLarge = TextStyle(fontFamily = PositionalFonts.medium, fontSize = 22.sp),
    titleMedium = TextStyle(fontFamily = PositionalFonts.medium, fontSize = 16.sp),
    bodyMedium = TextStyle(fontFamily = PositionalFonts.regular, fontSize = 14.sp),
    labelLarge = TextStyle(fontFamily = PositionalFonts.medium, fontSize = 14.sp),
)

fun Context.appAccentColor(): Int =
    obtainStyledAttributes(intArrayOf(R.attr.colorAppAccent)).use { it.getColor(0, getColor(R.color.positional)) }

@Composable
fun PositionalTheme(content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val accent = remember(context) { Color(context.appAccentColor()) }
    val background = colorResource(R.color.mainBackground)
    val primaryText = colorResource(R.color.textPrimary)
    val tertiaryText = colorResource(R.color.textTertiary)
    val divider = colorResource(R.color.dividerColor)
    val switchOff = colorResource(R.color.switch_off)
    val base = if (isSystemInDarkTheme()) darkColorScheme() else lightColorScheme()
    val colors = base.copy(
        primary = accent,
        onPrimary = Color.White,
        secondary = accent,
        background = background,
        surface = background,
        surfaceContainer = background,
        onBackground = primaryText,
        onSurface = primaryText,
        onSurfaceVariant = tertiaryText,
        outline = divider,
        outlineVariant = divider,
        surfaceContainerHighest = switchOff,
    )
    MaterialTheme(colorScheme = colors, typography = typography, content = content)
}

private val itemShape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)

@Composable
fun PreferenceCategory(title: String, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit) {
    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 20.dp)) {
        Text(
            text = title,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
            color = colorResource(R.color.textSecondary),
            modifier = Modifier.padding(15.dp),
        )
        HorizontalDivider(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 15.dp), thickness = Dp.Hairline, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline)
        content()
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
fun PreferenceItem(
    title: String,
    summary: String? = null,
    onLongClick: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    trailing: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(itemShape)
            .combinedClickable(onClick = onClick, onLongClick = onLongClick)
            .padding(15.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(text = title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            if (!summary.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                Text(text = summary, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
        }
        if (trailing != null) {
            Spacer(Modifier.width(16.dp))
            trailing()
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SwitchPreference(
    title: String,
    summary: String,
    checked: Boolean,
    onLongClick: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
) {
    PreferenceItem(
        title = title,
        summary = summary,
        onLongClick = onLongClick,
        trailing = { Switch(checked = checked, onCheckedChange = null) },
        onClick = { onCheckedChange(!checked) },
    )
}

@Composable
internal fun SettingsDialogHost(dialog: SettingsDialog, state: SettingsState, actions: SettingsActions, onDismiss: () -> Unit) {
    fun <T> select(action: (T) -> Unit): (T) -> Unit = {
        onDismiss()
        action(it)
    }
    when (dialog) {
        SettingsDialog.THEME -> ChoiceDialog(
            title = stringResource(R.string.theme),
            choices = SettingsLabels.themeModes.map { Choice(it, stringResource(SettingsLabels.theme(it)!!)) },
            selected = state.themeMode,
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onSelect = select(actions::setThemeMode),
        )
        SettingsDialog.ICON -> IconDialog(
            selected = state.iconIndex,
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onSelect = select(actions::setIcon),
        )
        SettingsDialog.CORNERS -> CornerDialog(
            initial = state.cornerRadius,
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onConfirm = select(actions::setCornerRadius),
        )
        SettingsDialog.UNITS -> ChoiceDialog(
            title = stringResource(R.string.units),
            choices = listOf(true, false).map { Choice(it, stringResource(SettingsLabels.unit(it))) },
            selected = state.isMetric,
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onSelect = select(actions::setMetric),
        )
        SettingsDialog.COORDINATES -> ChoiceDialog(
            title = stringResource(R.string.app_coordinates_format),
            choices = SettingsLabels.coordinateFormats.map { Choice(it, stringResource(SettingsLabels.coordinatesFormat(it)!!)) },
            selected = state.coordinatesFormat,
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onSelect = select(actions::setCoordinatesFormat),
        )
        SettingsDialog.PROVIDER -> ChoiceDialog(
            title = stringResource(R.string.location_provider),
            choices = SettingsLabels.providers.map {
                Choice(
                    it,
                    stringResource(SettingsLabels.locationProvider(it)!!),
                    stringResource(SettingsLabels.locationProviderDescription(it)!!),
                )
            },
            selected = state.locationProvider,
            note = stringResource(R.string.desc_location_provider_note),
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onSelect = select(actions::setLocationProvider),
        )
        SettingsDialog.LANGUAGE -> ChoiceDialog(
            title = stringResource(R.string.language),
            choices = SettingsLabels.languages().map { (code, name) ->
                Choice(code, name ?: stringResource(R.string.auto_system_default_language))
            },
            selected = state.language,
            onDismiss = onDismiss,
            onSelect = select(actions::setLanguage),
        )
    }
}


@Composable
private fun IconDialog(selected: Int, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onSelect: (Int) -> Unit) {
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.cancel)) } },
        title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.icon), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge) },
        text = {
            Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                AppIcons.icons.indices.chunked(ICONS_PER_ROW).forEach { row ->
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 6.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly) {
                        row.forEach { index ->
                            Box(
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .size(60.dp)
                                    .clip(CircleShape)
                                    .border(2.dp, if (index == selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else Color.Transparent, CircleShape)
                                    .clickable { onSelect(index) },
                            ) {
                                Image(mipmapPainter(AppIcons.icons[index].second), contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(50.dp))
                            }
                        }
                        repeat(ICONS_PER_ROW - row.size) { Box(Modifier.size(60.dp)) }
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
    )
}

@Composable
private fun CornerDialog(initial: Int, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onConfirm: (Int) -> Unit) {
    var value by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(initial.toFloat()) }
    val radius = value.roundToInt() / 5f
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { onConfirm(value.roundToInt()) }) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.ok)) } },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text(stringResource(android.R.string.cancel)) } },
        title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.corner_radius), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge) },
        text = {
            Column {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(96.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(with(LocalDensity.current) { radius.toDp() }))
                        .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary),
                )
                Text("$radius px", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 16.dp))
                Slider(
                    value = value,
                    onValueChange = { value = it },
                    valueRange = SettingsLabels.CORNER_MIN.toFloat()..SettingsLabels.CORNER_MAX.toFloat(),
                )
            }
        },
        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
    )
}

@Composable
private fun mipmapPainter(@DrawableRes id: Int): Painter {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    return remember(id) {
        BitmapPainter(ResourcesCompat.getDrawable(context.resources, id, context.theme)!!.toBitmap(ICON_BITMAP_SIZE, ICON_BITMAP_SIZE).asImageBitmap())
    }
}

private const val ICONS_PER_ROW = 4
private const val ICON_BITMAP_SIZE = 192

@Immutable
data class SettingsState(
    val hasLocationPermission: Boolean = true,
    val themeMode: Int = AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM,
    val isMetric: Boolean = true,
    val coordinatesFormat: Int = 0,
    val locationProvider: String = SettingsLabels.PROVIDER_ANDROID,
    val language: String = SettingsLabels.LANGUAGE_DEFAULT,
    val isCustomLocation: Boolean = false,
    val keepScreenOn: Boolean = false,
    val skipSplashScreen: Boolean = false,
    val iconIndex: Int = 0,
    val cornerRadius: Int = SettingsLabels.CORNER_DEFAULT,
    val versionName: String = "",
)

interface SettingsActions {
    fun requestPermission()
    fun setThemeMode(mode: Int)
    fun openAccent()
    fun setIcon(index: Int)
    fun setCornerRadius(value: Int)
    fun setSkipSplashScreen(enabled: Boolean)
    fun openArts()
    fun setMetric(metric: Boolean)
    fun setCoordinatesFormat(format: Int)
    fun setLocationProvider(provider: String)
    fun openCustomLocations()
    fun setCustomLocation(enabled: Boolean)
    fun setKeepScreenOn(enabled: Boolean)
    fun setLanguage(code: String)
    fun openLegal(@StringRes page: Int)
    fun openReleases()
    fun openRepository()
    fun openIssues()
}

internal enum class SettingsDialog { THEME, ICON, CORNERS, UNITS, COORDINATES, PROVIDER, LANGUAGE }

object SettingsLabels {
    const val THEME_AUTO = 4
    const val PROVIDER_ANDROID = "android"
    const val PROVIDER_FUSED = "fused"
    const val LANGUAGE_DEFAULT = "default"
    const val CORNER_MIN = 25
    const val CORNER_MAX = 400
    const val CORNER_DEFAULT = 150

    val legalPages = listOf(
        R.string.disclaimer,
        R.string.privacy_policy,
        R.string.terms_of_use,
        R.string.permissions,
        R.string.credits,
        R.string.internet_uses,
    )

    val themeModes = listOf(
        AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO,
        AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES,
        AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM,
        THEME_AUTO,
    )

    val coordinateFormats = listOf(0, 1, 2)

    val providers = listOf(PROVIDER_ANDROID, PROVIDER_FUSED)

    @StringRes
    fun theme(mode: Int): Int? = when (mode) {
        AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO -> R.string.theme_day
        AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES -> R.string.theme_night
        AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM -> R.string.theme_follow_system
        THEME_AUTO -> R.string.theme_auto
        else -> null
    }

    @StringRes
    fun unit(isMetric: Boolean): Int = if (isMetric) R.string.unit_metric else R.string.unit_imperial

    @StringRes
    fun coordinatesFormat(format: Int): Int? = when (format) {
        0 -> R.string.dd_dddddd
        1 -> R.string.dd_mm_mmm
        2 -> R.string.dd_mm_ss_sss
        else -> null
    }

    @StringRes
    fun locationProvider(provider: String): Int? = when (provider) {
        PROVIDER_ANDROID -> R.string.android_location_provider
        PROVIDER_FUSED -> R.string.fused_location_provider
        else -> null
    }

    @StringRes
    fun locationProviderDescription(provider: String): Int? = when (provider) {
        PROVIDER_ANDROID -> R.string.desc_android_location_provider
        PROVIDER_FUSED -> R.string.desc_fused_location_provider
        else -> null
    }

    fun languages(): List<Pair<String, String?>> {
        val (defaults, named) = LocaleHelper.localeList.partition { it.localeCode == LANGUAGE_DEFAULT }
        return defaults.map { it.localeCode to null } + named.sortedBy { it.language }.map { it.localeCode to it.language }
    }

    fun languageName(code: String): String? =
        if (code == LANGUAGE_DEFAULT) null else LocaleHelper.localeList.firstOrNull { it.localeCode == code }?.language
}

@Composable
fun SettingsScreen(state: SettingsState, actions: SettingsActions, topInset: Int) {
    val top = with(LocalDensity.current) { topInset.toDp() }
    var dialog by remember { mutableStateOf<SettingsDialog?>(null) }
    Surface(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        Column(
            Modifier
                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                .padding(top = top, bottom = dimensionResource(R.dimen.bottom_nav_height)),
        ) {
            Text(
                text = stringResource(R.string.settings),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 26.dp, vertical = 16.dp),
            )
            if (!state.hasLocationPermission) PermissionBanner(actions::requestPermission)
            AppearanceSection(state, actions) { dialog = it }
            ConfigurationSection(state, actions) { dialog = it }
            AboutSection(state, actions)
        }
    }
    dialog?.let { current -> SettingsDialogHost(current, state, actions) { dialog = null } }
}

@Composable
private fun PermissionBanner(onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(Color(0xFFFF4444))
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 15.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        Text(
            text = stringResource(R.string.no_location_permission_alert),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            color = Color.White,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.width(16.dp))
        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_bad_location), contentDescription = null, tint = Color.White)
    }
}

        SwitchPreference(

            checked = state.skipSplashScreen,
            onLongClick = actions::openArts,
            onCheckedChange = actions::setSkipSplashScreen,
        )
    }
}

private fun AboutSection(state: SettingsState, actions: SettingsActions) {
    var legalExpanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    PreferenceCategory(stringResource(R.string.about)) {

    }
}

package app.simple.positional.ui.launcher

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.Window
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.view.animation.AnimationUtils
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import androidx.appcompat.widget.AppCompatTextView
import androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import app.simple.positional.BuildConfig
import app.simple.positional.R
import app.simple.positional.activities.main.MainActivity
import app.simple.positional.constants.LauncherBackground
import app.simple.positional.constants.LocationPins
import app.simple.positional.preferences.GPSPreferences
import app.simple.positional.util.BitmapHelper.addLinearGradient
import app.simple.positional.util.BitmapHelper.addRadialGradient
import app.simple.positional.util.BitmapHelper.toBitmapKeepingSize

@SuppressLint("CustomSplashScreen")
class SplashScreen : Fragment() {
    private lateinit var launcherBackground: ImageView
    private lateinit var touchIndicator: ImageView
    private lateinit var icon: ImageView
    private lateinit var text: AppCompatTextView
    private lateinit var launcherContainer: ConstraintLayout

    private var randomDayValue: Int = 0
    private var randomNightValue: Int = 0
    private var colorOne: Int = 0x000000
    private var colorTwo: Int = 0x000000
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View? {
        val view = inflater.inflate(R.layout.fragment_launcher, container, false)

        launcherBackground = view.findViewById(R.id.launcher_background)
        touchIndicator = view.findViewById(R.id.touch_indicator)
        icon = view.findViewById(R.id.launcher_icon)
        text = view.findViewById(R.id.launcher_text)
        launcherContainer = view.findViewById(R.id.launcher_act)

        return view
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
            @Suppress("SetTextI18n")
            text.text = "Positional (Debug)"
        }

        randomDayValue = LauncherBackground.vectorBackground.indices.random()
        randomNightValue = LauncherBackground.vectorBackgroundNight.indices.random()

        when (this.resources.configuration.uiMode and Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK) {
            Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES -> {
                colorOne = LauncherBackground.vectorNightColors[randomNightValue][0]
                colorTwo = LauncherBackground.vectorNightColors[randomNightValue][1]
                launcherBackground.setImageResource(LauncherBackground.vectorBackgroundNight[randomNightValue])

                val window: Window = requireActivity().window
                window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DRAWS_SYSTEM_BAR_BACKGROUNDS)
                window.statusBarColor = Color.TRANSPARENT
            }
            Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_NO -> {
                colorOne = LauncherBackground.vectorColors[randomDayValue][0]
                colorTwo = LauncherBackground.vectorColors[randomDayValue][1]
                launcherBackground.setImageResource(LauncherBackground.vectorBackground[randomDayValue])
            }
            Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_UNDEFINED -> {
                colorOne = LauncherBackground.vectorColors[randomDayValue][0]
                colorTwo = LauncherBackground.vectorColors[randomDayValue][1]
                launcherBackground.setImageResource(LauncherBackground.vectorBackground[randomDayValue])
            }
        }

        touchIndicator.setImageBitmap(R.drawable.ic_touch_indicator
                .toBitmapKeepingSize(context = requireContext(), 6, 255).let {
                    addRadialGradient(it, colorTwo)
                })

        icon.setImageBitmap(LocationPins.locationsPins[GPSPreferences.getPinSkin()]
                .toBitmapKeepingSize(context = requireContext(), 6, 255)
                .addLinearGradient(intArrayOf(colorOne, colorTwo)))

        icon.startAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(requireContext(), R.anim.launcher_icon))
        text.startAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(requireContext(), R.anim.image_in))

        launcherContainer.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
                    touchIndicator.x = event.x - touchIndicator.width / 2
                    touchIndicator.y = event.y - touchIndicator.height / 2
                    touchIndicator.animate().scaleX(1.2f).scaleY(1.2f).alpha(1.0f).setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator()).start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    touchIndicator.x = event.x - touchIndicator.width / 2f
                    touchIndicator.y = event.y - touchIndicator.height / 2f
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                    touchIndicator.animate().scaleX(0.5f).scaleY(0.5f).alpha(0f).start()
                    runPostDelayed(1000)
                }
            }

            true
        }
    }

    private fun runPostDelayed(delay: Long) {
        handler.postDelayed({
            if (requireActivity().isActivityFinishing()) return@postDelayed
            runIntent()
        }, delay)
    }

    private fun runIntent() {
        val intent = Intent(requireActivity(), MainActivity::class.java)
        intent.flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
        intent.action = requireActivity().intent.action
        startActivity(intent)
        requireActivity().finish()
    }

    private fun Activity.isActivityFinishing(): Boolean {
        return this.isFinishing || this.isDestroyed
    }

    override fun onPause() {
        icon.clearAnimation()
        text.clearAnimation()
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        super.onPause()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        runPostDelayed(2000)
        super.onResume()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    companion object {
        fun newInstance(): SplashScreen {
            return SplashScreen()
        }
    }
}
